what: A node placed around a circle (like the five business · field nodes) follows the hand exactly when dragged, and the endpoints and control points of the two Bezier curves attached to that node are pulled and bent along with it. On release it springs back (stiffness 180 · damping 12, max step 1/30s), overshooting its place and bouncing, and stops below distance .3px · speed 3px/s. If dragged more than 6px, the link navigation for that press is blocked. On hover the node scales to 1.14× over .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)

options.slop: Distance (px) at which a press counts as a drag, default 6

use: AB
note: data-points is eight numbers in svg viewBox coordinates: start point, two control points, end point. The interaction that switches a line to the accent color (hovering a node colors only the connected line) is done with :has in the consumer’s css — dragging is this part’s job, so it uses touch-action: none (only on the nodes, not on the whole board)
